name: Spandeck Engineering v DSTA [2007] 4 SLR 100
summary: Landmark Singapore Court of Appeal establishing unified two-stage test for duty of care in negligence: (1) factual foreseeability, then (2) proximity and policy considerations. Departing from English Caparo three-stage test. Shows Singapore developing its own common law independently. Consistently applied as definitive Singapore negligence authority.
